subject: Surge credit structure + provisional commit conversion for BlueRipple launch
messages:
From: Elena Reyes <elena.reyes@blueripple.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Chu <tom.chu@blueripple.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected launch spike — temporary quota increase & credits?

Hi Grace / Laura,

Quick note from launch day: our real-time tagging pipeline hit a sustained spike this morning (peak ~12k requests/min, 25x our expected baseline) and we racked up an estimated $18,400 in overrun usage in the first 4 hours. We're still stabilizing but we need a short-term solution to avoid an invoice shock.

Options we'd like to understand:
- One-time surge credit to offset the immediate invoice while we smooth traffic
- Temporary quota bump for 72 hours to keep things running while we finish the fallback rollout
- Path to convert this temporary relief into a short-term committed capacity (1–3 months) if that helps reduce unit cost

Can Redwood propose a structure (credit %, cap, and PO flow) we can present to finance? We have a procurement window this week and can sign a PO quickly if terms are clear.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Reyes
Head of Product Ops, BlueRipple
elena.reyes@blueripple.com
+1 415-555-0198

Attachment: brief_launch_metrics.csv (stub)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Reyes <elena.reyes@blueripple.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — temporary quota increase & credits?

Hi Elena — sorry to hear you hit that spike. Appreciate the quick details.

We can offer a two-part path to address the immediate billing concern and provide predictability:

1) Immediate relief: a one-time surge credit equal to 30% of the overrun amount (cap $7,500) applied to the next invoice. This gets you time to stabilize without large near-term cashflow impact.

2) Provisional commit: if you can commit to a 6-month term at a modest uplift (covers current baseline + headroom), we will convert the remainder of the overrun into a prorated prepay against the first invoice and reduce the ongoing unit rate by 18% vs PAYG. The mechanics:
   - BlueRipple signs a 6-month provisional commit for X tokens/mo (we'll finalize numbers once you share an avg baseline).
   - Overrun today: $18,400 — apply 30% surge credit = $5,520 credit. Remaining $12,880 can be rolled into month 1 of the provisional commit (prorated).
   - PO flow: we can accept a signed PO for the provisional commit; once PO is received, we'll generate an amendment + DocuSign for the commit terms and apply the credits/rollover.

I've attached a quick quote (blueripple_burst_quote_v3.pdf) and a PO template. If this structure works, Ben and Vivek are on copy to finalize the pricing concession and accounting treatment.

Next steps:
- Elena/BlueRipple: confirm you can route a PO by end-of-week (10/29)
- Redwood: Ben to confirm final discount % and finance to approve treatment
- Legal: prepare amendment and DocuSign link once PO is in place

Happy to sync over a 20-min call if you want to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0132

Attachments: blueripple_burst_quote_v3.pdf (stub), blueripple_po_draft.xlsx (stub)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: pricing math for BlueRipple provisional commit

Team — quick internal note with the numbers I used to justify the 18% ongoing discount in Grace's note:

Assumptions (provisional):
- Baseline tokens/mo: 120M
- Proposed commit: 150M tokens/mo (gives ~25% headroom)
- PAYG unit rate: $0.00045/token
- Commit blended unit rate target: $0.000369/token ( ~18% off PAYG)

Impact:
- Monthly savings vs PAYG at baseline: ~ $9,720/mo
- Revenue recognition: first-month invoice will include the rolled-over remainder of the overrun ($12,880) as a one-time charge offset by the $5,520 surge credit — net one-time of $7,360 applied to month 1, then commit invoice thereafter

Approval asks: Vivek — can finance accept the rollover of a one-time overrun into month 1 of a commit (with the credit applied) without additional deferred revenue complexity? Also, confirm discount tolerance (we proposed 18%, flexibility to 15% if needed).

If finance signs off, I can send a finalized quote and push for PO by 10/29 (BlueRipple indicated they can meet that window).

Thanks — Ben
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: pricing math for BlueRipple provisional commit

Ben / Grace — reviewed. Finance is comfortable with the proposed mechanics with the following conditions:

1) Credit mechanics: approve 30% surge credit capped at $7,500 as an operational concession (OK).
2) Rollover: the remaining overrun can be invoiced in month 1 as a one-time line item and offset by the credit. Recognize revenue on delivery; minimal deferred rev complexity given short (6-mo) commit.
3) Discount: approve final discount up to 25% if BlueRipple signs the 6-month commit and PO is in our system by 2026-10-29. If PO slips past that date, discount drops to 15%.

Please update the quote to include the date-limited discount clause and add the following legal note: "Discount contingent on signed PO within the offer window; overrun rollover applied only after PO is received." Our legal team will prepare the amendment once we have the PO.

Laura — please coordinate the DocuSign amendment and loop Legal for the clause above. Ben — once updated, send the HubSpot deal link and I will instruct accounting to expect the PO.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Finance — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Surge credit structure + provisional commit conversion for BlueRipple launch

Thanks Grace & team — that structure works for us. We can route a PO this week and are aligned on a 6-month provisional commit.

Action items from our side:
- Procurement will push a PO (using your attached template) by 10/29.
- We accept the 30% surge credit (cap $7,500) and will include the rollover language in the PO note.
- Please send the DocuSign amendment and final quote with the time-limited discount clause (Vivek's email) so procurement has the exact doc to sign.

CC'ing Tom (ops) who will coordinate a short traffic-smoothing runbook with our SREs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Elena

Elena Reyes
Head of Product Ops, BlueRipple
